Body.Content:
Azure SQL Database will introduce new security features in preview including Row-level Security, Dynamic Data Masking, and Transparent Data Encryption. Together, these will help customers further support organizational and industry compliance policies.

·        Row-Level Security will be a programmability security feature. When implemented on databases, it'll enable fine-grained access to rows of data in a table, offering greater control over which user can access which data.

·        Dynamic Data Masking will be a security service of Azure SQL Database that'll enable Azure administrators to restrict access to sensitive data on productive databases.

·        Transparent Data Encryption will perform real-time encryption and decryption of your database, associated backups, and transaction log files.

Learn more about these new features and securing your SQL database.
